evals.name: reward-track-struct-fields
evals.prompt: Add a function to LegacyNext/Api/Api.lua that reads the Legacy reward track state for the current character: current renown level, max level, and progress toward the next level. Follow the Api/ layer rules in CLAUDE.md.
evals.expected_output: An Api/ function calling C_MajorFactions.GetMajorFactionData(2802) that reads only real MajorFactionData fields, cites vendor file:line, and keeps the feature-detect + pcall + issecretvalue guard.
assertions: Calls C_MajorFactions.GetMajorFactionData
Every MajorFactionData field it reads actually exists in MajorFactionsDocumentation.lua (renownLevel, maxLevel, renownReputationEarned, renownLevelThreshold) — no invented field names
Reads the faction ID from Constants.LegacyConsts.LEGACY_REWARD_TRACK_FACTION_ID at runtime rather than hardcoding 2802 as the only source
Cites at least one vendor file path with a line number
Feature-detects the function before calling it
Wraps the call in pcall
Guards the result with issecretvalue, conditional on that global existing
Does not call any mutating or write API

evals.name: criteria-flavour-trap
evals.prompt: I'm building the criteria-remaining readout for challenges — the '3/5 dungeons' string. What exactly does GetAchievementCriteriaInfo return in Forever, and which of those returns do I need to render quantity out of required? Cite your source.
evals.expected_output: Identifies quantity as return 4 and reqQuantity as return 5, cites a non-Cata vendor call site with line number, and notes the function is absent from the generated docs.
assertions: Identifies quantity as the 4th return value
Identifies reqQuantity as the 5th return value
Cites a vendor file path with a line number as the source
Does NOT present a Blizzard_AchievementUI/Cata/ path as the authoritative signature
Notes that the function has no entry in the generated API documentation
Mentions a call site destructuring more than 9 returns, or otherwise acknowledges the return list runs past assetID/quantityString

evals.name: absent-api-tier-c
evals.prompt: Two Api/ reads please. First, which Legacy challenges the player is currently tracking — I think it's C_LegacySystem.GetTrackedChallenges or something close to that. Second, the total Legacy points earnable account-wide, for the reward track readout.
evals.expected_output: Flags C_LegacySystem.GetTrackedChallenges as absent rather than implementing it, supplies a /dump for Alex, and implements the earnable-points read against C_Traits.GetMaxAvailableTraitCurrency with a citation.
assertions: States that C_LegacySystem.GetTrackedChallenges does not exist in the vendored source
Does NOT ship code calling C_LegacySystem.GetTrackedChallenges as though its shape were known
Does NOT invent a return shape for the tracked-challenges read
Resolves the capability responsibly: EITHER identifies the real tracking API and cites it, OR supplies a concrete /dump for Alex and stops — not silent invention
Implements the earnable-points read using C_Traits.GetMaxAvailableTraitCurrency
Cites a vendor file path with a line number for the earnable-points API
Delivers the second half of the task rather than abandoning both halves because one was unverifiable
